name: BOUILLOTTE
description: Bouillotte is a historic 18th-century French gambling game that represents a critical evolution in the history of Poker. Emerging during the French Revolution as a derivative of Brelan, it is a fast-paced vying game for 3-5 players. It is unique for its use of a stripped pack and a 'retourné' (turned card) that can complete a player's Brelan into a Brelan Carré (four-of-a-kind). It famously introduced the concept of the 'Cave' (fixed chip stack), which restricted betting to the chips currently on the table.

content.text: Bouillotte is a historic 18th-century French gambling game that represents a critical evolution in the history of Poker. Emerging during the French Revolution as a derivative of Brelan, it is a fast-paced vying game for 3-5 players. It is unique for its use of a stripped pack and a 'retourné' (turned card) that can complete a player's Brelan into a Brelan Carré (four-of-a-kind). It famously introduced the concept of the 'Cave' (fixed chip stack), which restricted betting to the chips currently on the table.

Bouillotte was developed in late 18th-century France as a modification of Brelan to regulate betting behavior during the volatile Revolutionary period. It became so popular that it influenced the development of early American Stud Poker.
4 players are standard (using 20 cards). 3 players remove Queens (16 cards). 5 players add Jacks (24 cards).
A stripped piquet pack: Ace, King, Queen, 9, 8 in each suit. Ranking: A-K-Q-9-8.
Players ante into the pot. Dealer deals 3 cards to each player and turns the next card face-up (the retourné).

items.text: Brelan (Parent Game): The older version without the retourné card; play is purely based on the 3-card hand.
